title: The Purpose-Driven Life
author: Rick Warren
summary: Pastor Rick Warren offers a forty-day Christian devotional programme asking why we are here. Each short chapter ends with questions, with the answer framed around worship, fellowship, growth, service and mission.
readIf: you are a Christian looking for a structured daily devotional on meaning and purpose.
skipIf: you want a non-religious approach to purpose or find devotional writing preachy.
